ingredients.name: Ashwagandha (Withania somnifera)
ingredients.about: An adaptogenic herb used for centuries in Ayurvedic tradition. Ashwagandha supports the body's natural response to stress and helps maintain healthy cortisol levels already within the normal range.*

body: Busy days, packed schedules and screens that never turn off make it hard to feel settled. Calm Essence gives you a simple daily habit: two ashwagandha gummies that support a calm, balanced mood and a healthy response to everyday stress.*

Ashwagandha is one of the most studied adaptogens. Adaptogens are herbs that help the body adapt to everyday stressors. We put it in a chewable gummy so it fits into your morning or evening without a pill.
Every batch is made in the USA in a GMP-certified, FDA-registered facility and third-party tested for purity.

faq.q: When should I take ashwagandha gummies?
faq.a: Take two gummies once a day. Many people take them at the same time each day, either in the morning or in the evening, to make it part of a routine.

faq.q: How long does it take to notice a difference?
faq.a: Everyone is different. Most people use ashwagandha consistently for several weeks before deciding how it works for them.

faq.q: Can I take Calm Essence with other supplements or medications?
faq.a: Talk with your healthcare provider before combining supplements with medications, or if you are pregnant, nursing or have a medical condition.

faq.q: How long before bed should I take Tranquil Nights?
faq.a: Take two gummies about 30 to 60 minutes before you plan to sleep.

faq.q: Will sleep gummies make me groggy in the morning?
faq.a: Most people feel fine in the morning, but everyone responds differently. Start with the suggested serving and avoid driving or operating machinery after taking it.

faq.q: Can I take melatonin gummies every night?
faq.a: Many adults use melatonin nightly for short periods. Ask your healthcare provider about long-term use or if you take other medications.

body: Walking, lifting, gardening, getting up off the floor with the grandkids: your joints are part of everything you do. Flexiease delivers glucosamine in a chewable gummy so supporting your joints does not mean swallowing oversized tablets.*
Glucosamine is one of the most widely used joint-support nutrients. Take two gummies a day and stay consistent.

faq.q: How long should I take glucosamine gummies?
faq.a: Joint-support nutrients work best with consistent daily use. Most people take them for at least a few months before judging how they feel.

faq.q: Is glucosamine safe for people with shellfish allergies?
faq.a: Glucosamine is often sourced from shellfish. If you have a shellfish allergy, check the label and talk with your healthcare provider before use.

faq.q: Can I take Flexiease with other joint supplements?
faq.a: Check the labels to avoid doubling up on glucosamine, and ask your healthcare provider if you take blood thinners or other medications.

faq.q: Should I take multivitamin gummies with food?
